Release v1.3.0c (27 November 2019) |previous_update = [[Release v1.2]] |next_update = [[Release v1.4]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Release v1.3''' was the fifteenth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 25th of November 2019. This update is notable for bringing the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]]. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Release v1.3''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed four updates, the main Release v1.3.0 update (released 25 November 2019) and three minor updates, the Release v1.3.0a (released 27 November 2019), Release v1.3.0b (released 27 November 2019) and Release v1.3.0b (released 27 November 2019). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were added as part of the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]]: *[[Glitched Giant]] *[[Bruh]] *[[Bug]] *[[Jaxe (Nightmare Carnival)|Jaxe]] *[[Mechanical Rot (Legacy)|Mechanical Rot]] *[[SCT]] *[[Creator]] *[[Developer 1]] *[[Developer 2]] *[[Developer 3]] *[[A]] *[[B]] *[[C]] ===Maps=== *[[Farm Lands]] (Survival) *[[Deserted Village]] (Survival) ===Crates=== *New skins for the [[Premium Crate]] **Skins: ***[[Medic]]: {{Color|Premium|Cyber}} ***[[Rocketeer]]: {{Color|Premium|Bosanka}} ***[[Pyromancer]]: {{Color|Premium|Acidic}} ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[DJ Booth]] nerfed. **'''Level 2''' ***[[Range Buff]] changed from {{Tooltip|10% > 20%|+10%}} to {{Tooltip|10% > 15%|+5%}}. **'''Level 4''' ***[[Range Buff]] changed from {{Tooltip|20% > 35%|+15%}} to {{Tooltip|15% > 25%|+10%}}. **'''Level 5''' ***[[Range Buff]] changed from {{Tooltip|35% > 50%|+15%}} to {{Tooltip|25% > 35%|+10%}}. *{{Color|Premium|Neon Rave}} [[DJ Booth]] default music changed from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ZfQsbVfgwE Jack O Bot] to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jH9_e0rolZo Neon Rave]. *[[Tank]] health increased from 5,000 to 12,000. *[[Summoner Boss]] changed. **Health increased from 8,000 to 12,000. **Speed increased from Average to Above Average. *[[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] changed. **Health increased from 125,000 to 150,000. **Speed increased from Very Slow to Slow. *[[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode wave 40 beginning text changed from "''Boss text here lol''" to "''Things are getting really. Really. Heated.''". *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode wave structure changed. :In '''Release v1.3.0a''': *[[Giant Boss]] speed increased from Below Average to Average. *[[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]] health increased from 4,000 to 5,000. *[[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]] changed. **Health increased from 12,000 to 20,000. **Speed increased from Slow to Above Average. *[[Creator]] health increased from 250,000 to 300,000. *Proper [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] activation method added as it is no longer being tested. :In '''Release v1.3.0b''': *[[Creator]] health increased from 300,000 to 500,000. *The time limit for activating the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] increased from 999 seconds to 1,020 seconds. :In '''Release v1.3.0c''': *[[Creator]] changed. **Health increased from 500,000 to 750,000. **Speed increased from Extremely Slow to Slow. *The time limit for activating the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] decreased from 1,020 seconds to 1,005 seconds. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} CyberMedicGameIcon.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's update log on the devforum.
